caption: The video depicts a narrow aisle inside a server room, flanked by glass-fronted racks glowing in cool blue and dotted with small green status lights that blink independently of the people. A man in a white dress shirt, dark trousers and an ID lanyard moves steadily toward the viewpoint down the corridor, walking beside a woman in similar attire who cradles a tablet and keeps her gaze fixed downward on its screen. Their size on screen stays roughly constant as the corridor recedes, showing the camera tracks backward at a matching pace. Glossy panels on either side mirror the two figures and the racks, the reflected silhouettes shifting in step with the real subjects. Behind the man, a third dark-haired figure is largely hidden, only a sliver showing. As the excerpt progresses, her head and a white sleeve emerge between the two walkers. The tablet woman keeps her head bowed for most of the run. Later she lifts it, turning her gaze toward the man. His own head shifts from a downward glance to a level look.
relations: Camera retreats matching forward walk, keeping the two figures' screen size roughly constant.
The third figure's head and white sleeve gradually emerge between the two walkers.
Tablet woman lifts her head from downward gaze, turning it toward the man.
Man's head shifts from downward glance to level look as reflections track his motion.
